newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keisei Elec up on Oriental Land listing prospects.
newsitem.headline: Keisei Elec up on Oriental Land listing prospects.

text.p: Shares in Keisei Electric Railway Co Ltd rose in early morning trade on Monday, helped by the prospective listing of Oriental Land, which is expected later this year, traders said.
Keisei Electric Railway is one of the major share holders of Oriental Land, which operates Tokyo Disneyland.
At 0055 GMT, the share price was up 20 yen at 1,100 yen. Volume was 718,000 shares, marking the second heaviest trade.
Traders said the smooth listing of West Japan Railway Co turned investors' attention to Oriental Land, fuelling hopes that the listing will lift the market.
